# Datamining: Marshal-Mallow Mini Season Fishing Event 2025

![Datamining: Marshal-Mallow Mini Season Fishing Event 2025](/uploads/540_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**[Update August 12, 2025]** The mini season has been visible since 4 p.m. today, the challenges come at 6 p.m. **Weather station reward added to article.**

A new mini season is just around the corner: the Marshal Mallow Mini Season Fishing Event.

**Period: August 12th - 08/26/2025**

This mini season will also feature a new area alongside the current season, as we already saw with the Outlaws of Appalachia Challenge event. There you can unlock the Mini Season rewards for tickets. Tickets are the same for season and mini-season.

You can earn tickets by completing the season and/or mini-season challenges.

## Free Challenge Item

The Mini Season Challenges require you to wear a hat, which you will receive for free when the challenge starts **during the Mini Season**.

### Marshal Mallow Fishing Hat

A sweet headgear for every hobby angler.

- THIS CLOTHING CAN BE CRAFTED AT ARMOR WORKBENCHES. -

*Note:* It is now possible to complete these challenges in Power Armor. There is a new function in the challenges called "WornInOrOutOfPowerArmor", which detects when you wear the backpack before entering the PA and counts it towards the challenges.

## Mini-Season Rewards

**Marshal Mallow Angel Display Case**

Freshly pulled from the dirtiest Appalachian waters, your next catch will go straight into this Marshal Mallow Fishing Display Case!

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS WILL BE DISPLAYED IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

**Fishing Marshal Mallow Plushie**

With Marshal Mallow, fishing becomes a super sweet pastime.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS WILL BE DISPLAYED IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

**Fishing Rod Paint (Marshal Mallow)**

Recommended by the fluffiest fisherman in all the wasteland!

- ITEM CAN BE CRAFTED AT CRAFT WORKBENCHES. -
